content: Nzambi mwena Mwana wandi kisi zonzila
Muna tangwa dya khulu, Nzambi kakala zonza kwena batata betu mbala za lawu amana mu mitundu mya lawu muna nzila ya bambikudi,
kaasi buthwena, mu bilumbu byabi bya tsuka, kátuzonzila mwena Mwana wandi mosi wuna kásikununa swana wa byosu, muna nzila ya yandi wuna káhangila tsi.

Mwana meni wuna kenina mutsyenzya wa khembu ya Nzambi amana kenina kifwani kya mukwandi kya buna kenina Nzambi, amana ndinga ya yandi ya hamu yisi zyamisa tsi. Ku manima ma kusemisa batu ku masumu ma bawu, wázakala kuna koku dya kitata dya kipfumu kya Nzambi, muna bisoka bya mazilu.
Mwana wa Nzambi kenina mbuta kwena banzyo
Bwosu kákituka mbuta kwena banzyo Nzambi wámuheka zina dihitini dina dya bawu.
Mu kyedika, keti kwena mosi wa banzyo Nzambi kázimbwala kedi:

content.text: «Ngeyi wenina Mwana wama,
tuka lelu dyadi, meni yikubutini.»

content: Amana khaniku kazimbula kwena wanzyo mosi:

content.text: «Tata yikála kikuma kya yandi
amana kakála Mwana kikuma kya meni.»
Kaasi mu tangwa káhitika Mwana wandi wa tsomi muna tsi, wuzimbudini:
«Banzyo ba Nzambi boosu bamufukamina.»
«Nzambi, banzyo bandi, kisi bakitula bitembu
amana basadi bandi kisi bakitula mileku mya mbawu.»

content: Kaasi Nzambi kázimbula kikuma kya Mwana wandi: Wenina Nzambi,

content.text: «Kiti kyaku kya luyalu kyásikila mvula yi mvula.
Koka dya masonga maku dyenina koka dya luyalu lwaku.
Wisi zola masonga, amana wámenga mbi,
yi hakana Nzambi, Nzambi waku, kákusodila
mu kukusita mafuta ma thumbama,
amana wákusola kuhita bakwenu khunda.»
«Ngeyi, Pfumu, wátunga tsi muna luyandiku,
amana mazilu menina muhangu wa moku maku.
Byosu byabina byazíluka, kaasi ngeyi wenina.
Tsi yi zilu byakúlwakila hanga miledi mya khulu;
wavúngabya hanga muzaka wumosi,
amana byasóba hanga muledi wumosi phi.
Kaasi ngeyi wenina phila mosi kaka,
amana luzingu lwaku lweku yi tsuka.»

content: Amana Nzambi kázimbulaku kedi keti kwena mosi wa banzyo bandi:

content.text: «Awisa sikuka ku kitata kyama,
yi kuna yikítwala bambeni baku
kidyatilu kya bitambi byaku.»

content: Aketi banzyo benina bitembu, bana byenina mu kisalu kya Nzambi: Nzambi kisi batuma kikuma kya kusadisaka batu babana bakwisa vwa luhulusu.
